description:
The embeddable runtime core: everything the runtime is, except the decision to be an application.
    An application that already exists — a host platform, say — puts this jar on its classpath and gets
    the trust loop, the governance surface and the security filter chain through one auto-configuration;
    keelbase4j-runtime is the thin application that does the same thing for a standalone deployment.
    What is deliberately absent here is the application's half: no server configuration, no datasource
    of its own, no context path (ADR-0017 D4/D5).
